title: Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act
long_title: AN ACT TO AMEND THE STAMP DUTY (SPECIAL PROVISIONS) ACT, NO. 12 OF 2006

body.heading: Short title and the date of operation.
body.raw_text: 1. (1) This Act may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act, No. 10 of 2008. (2) The provisions of this Act, shall be deemed for all purposes to have come into operation from January 1, 2008.
body.text: (1) This Act may be cited as the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) (Amendment) Act, No. 10 of 2008. (2) The provisions of this Act, shall be deemed for all purposes to have come into operation from January 1, 2008.

body.heading: Amendment of section 6 of Act, No. 12 of 2006.
body.raw_text: 2. Section 6 of the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006 (hereinafter referred to as the “principal enactment”) is hereby amended as follows:— (1) in paragraph (d) of that section, by the substitution for the words “credit card holder; and”, of the words “credit card holder;”; (2) by the insertion, immediately after paragraph (d), of the following new paragraphs:— “(dd) in the case of a warrant to act as Notary Public, by the person applying for the office of Notary; (ddd) in the case of a licence, by the person applying for the same; and”.

provision.raw_text: (1) Otherwise than, when stamp duty is enactment. compounded in terms of section 7, the stamp duty payable on any specified instrument shall be paid by means of affixing adhesive stamps to the required value, prior to, or at the time of, the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) (Amendment) execution of the instrument. The value of the duty so paid shall be specified on the the instrument so executed: Provided that, share transfers executed in Sri shall be stamped within one month from execution of the same. (2) Stamp duty payable on any specified instrument relating to a mortgage or lease of any immovable property may be paid, prior to, or at of, the execution of the specified instrument, to a prescribed bank. Where however, stamp duty cannot be so paid due to reasons the control of the person by whom the duty is payable, the stamp duty shall be the prescribed bank within seven days date of such execution. The bank shall thereupon issue a certificate in the prescribed certifying that the stamp duty has been paid and such certificate shall be affixed to instrument so executed. (3) Any person executing a specified instrument shall at the time of the execution of specified instrument which is not stamped impressed stamp, cancel the stamps by writing or marking in ink on or across stamp, his name or initials, thereby preventing the stamp from being used again. where such specified instrument bears adhesive stamp of the value of fifty rupees or such stamp shall be cancelled by the person executing a specified instrument by perforating by either cutting or pricking the stamp suitable instrument.
